segments.an5.38:1.3: Ye te, bhikkhave, loke santo sappurisā te saddhaññeva paṭhamaṃ anukampantā anukampanti, no tathā assaddhaṃ;
segments.an5.38:1.4: saddhaññeva paṭhamaṃ upasaṅkamantā upasaṅkamanti, no tathā assaddhaṃ;
segments.an5.38:1.5: saddhaññeva paṭhamaṃ paṭiggaṇhantā paṭiggaṇhanti, no tathā assaddhaṃ;
segments.an5.38:1.6: saddhaññeva paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ desentā desenti, no tathā assaddhaṃ;
segments.an5.38:1.7: saddho kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
segments.an5.38:1.8: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca saddhe kulaputte ānisaṃsā.
segments.an5.38:2.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, subhūmiyaṃ catumahāpathe mahānigrodho samantā pakkhīnaṃ paṭisaraṇaṃ hoti;
segments.an5.38:2.2: evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, saddho kulaputto bahuno janassa paṭisaraṇaṃ hoti bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānan”ti.
segments.an5.38:7.3: Yaṃ so dhammaṃ idhaññāya, parinibbāti anāsavo”ti.

lines: Chāyaṃ chāyatthikā yantīti chāyāya atthikāva chāyaṃ upagacchanti.
Aṭṭhame anukampantīti “sabbe sattā sukhī hontu averā abyāpajjā”ti evaṃ hitapharaṇena anuggaṇhanti.
Apica upaṭṭhākānaṃ gehaṃ aññe sīlavante sabrahmacārino gahetvā pavisantāpi anuggaṇhanti nāma.
Kodhamānathaddhatāya rahitanti kodhamānavasena uppanno yo thaddhabhāvo cittassa uddhumātalakkhaṇo, tena virahitanti attho.
Yo kāyiko avītikkamo, vācasiko avītikkamo, kāyikavācasiko avītikkamo, idaṃ vuccati soraccaṃ.
Sabbopi sīlasaṃvaro soraccan”ti evamāgatena sīlasaṃvarasaṅkhātena soratabhāvena.

Yā sā vācā thaddhakā kakkasā pharusā kaṭukā abhisajjanī kodhasāmantā asamādhisaṃvattanikā, tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ pahāya yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā, tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
Yā tattha saṇhavācatā sakhilavācatā apharusavācatā, idaṃ vuccati sākhalyan”ti (dha. sa.1350) evaṃ vuttena sammodakamudubhāvena samannāgataṃ.
